snp5.16:1.1: NIṬṬHITĀ. Mogharājamāṇavapucchā (15). "Dvāhaṃ Sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, icc-āyasmā Mogharājā na me vyākāsi cakkhumā, ‘yāvatatiyañ ca devisi vyākarotī' ti me sutam: || ||
snp5.16:2.1: ‘Ayaṃ loko, paro loko, Brahmaloko sadevako.' diṭṭhin te nābhijānāmi Gotamassa yasassino. || ||
snp5.16:3.1: Evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ atthi pañhena āgamaṃ: kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ maccurājā na passati". || ||
snp5.16:4.1: "Suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu Mogharāja sadā sato attānuciṭṭhiṃ ūhacca, evaṃ maccutaro siyā: evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ maccurājā na passatī" ti || || MOGHARĀJAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
